title: factdiff resolve and review_items call Doc.locate with cites=1, so a data row anchored with several citations may not relocate
goal: Every caller of Doc.locate (factdiff.py resolve and review_items, census.py) passes the fact's real citation count, as anchoring does, so a data row located by the second look relocates on a changed page as modified instead of falling to not-found or score.

run: import re,sys; sys.exit(1 if re.search(r'd\.locate\(fact_text\((fact|text)\)\)', open('_tools/factdiff.py').read()) else 0)

repro_reason: found by reading factdiff.py in the SP-ilje65fa review; it shows only on a changed source whose cited data row has several citations, so the repro reads the calls that pass no citation count
